description: Update your salary/compensation details. IMPORTANT: For INR (currency code 2), pass values in lakhs (e.g., 20 for 20 lakhs). For all other currencies (USD, etc.), pass values in thousands (e.g., 400 for $400K). Use get_currencies to look up currency codes.

base.description: Base salary. For INR: in lakhs (e.g., 20 = 20 lakhs). For USD/others: in thousands (e.g., 400 = $400K)

bonus.description: Annual bonus. Same unit convention as base

currency.description: Currency code. Use get_currencies to look up valid codes (e.g., 2 = INR, 3 = USD)

signingBonus.description: Signing bonus. Same unit convention as base

stocks.description: Annual stock/equity value. Same unit convention as base

targetSalary.description: Target salary. Same unit convention as base

name: update_salary
